paper_title: PM-KVQ Progressive Mixed-precision KV Cache Quantization for Long-CoT   LLMs
caption: : DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B

model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the sensitivity of different block indices for two types of quantization, 4-Fbit and 2-Fbit. The horizontal axis represents the block index, labeled from 0 to 63, while the vertical axis represents sensitivity on a logarithmic scale, ranging from approximately 10^-6 to 10^-4. The chart features grouped bars, with each group containing two bars representing 4-Fbit (blue) and 2-Fbit (green) quantization. The bars are generally sorted in ascending order of block index, with some variation in the height of the bars. The 2-Fbit bars are visible for block indices 0-31 and 48-55, while the 4-Fbit bars are visible for block indices 25-63, with both bars visible for block indices 25-31 and 48-55, indicating overlapping values. The height of the bars varies, with the tallest 4-Fbit bar at block index 62 reaching approximately 1.2 x 10^-4 and the shortest 2-Fbit bar at block index 2 reaching approximately 8 x 10^-7.
model_annotations.German: The chart illustrates the sensitivity of different block indices for two types of Fbit configurations, 4-Fbit and 2-Fbit, in a KV Cache Quantization for Long-CoT LLMs. The horizontal axis represents the Block Index, labeled with values ranging from 0 to 63, and is categorized in ascending order. The vertical axis is labeled "Sensitivity" and features a logarithmic scale, spanning from approximately 10^-6 to 10^-4. The bars are grouped by Block Index, with each group containing two bars representing 4-Fbit and 2-Fbit configurations, colored blue and green, respectively. For Block Index values 0 to 26, only the 2-Fbit bars are visible, with the shortest bar at around 1.8 x 10^-6 and the tallest at approximately 1.2 x 10^-5. For Block Index values 27 to 63, both 4-Fbit and 2-Fbit bars are visible, with the 4-Fbit bars generally being taller, especially towards the higher Block Index values, where the tallest 4-Fbit bar reaches around 1.3 x 10^-4 at Block Index 62. The bars are not sorted in any particular order other than being grouped by Block Index, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color representation.
